description: Revoke the end user's delegation from Otto's side and confirm by read-back that it no longer exists; from then on this server submits nothing for that user (fail-closed, even if the read-back had failed). Arguments: EITHER { accessToken } (the user path — the server resolves the user from the token) OR { userId, support_reason } (the support path, for an operator holding the server secret; the reason is logged, the token never is). Server-to-server only: the caller presents Otto's delegation secret in the `x-otto-delegation-auth` request header (never in arguments); a call without it is refused before anything is read. The listed input schema is intentionally permissive — the strict schema is validated after the caller is authenticated.
name: otto_delegation_revoke
title: Revoke one end user's delegation, developer-side, confirmed by read-back
